content: The Justin Sun Prize is a decentralized mathematical and scientific bounty initiative launched by TRON founder Justin Sun on September 16, 2026, offering up to $1 million per verified solution. https://www.hejustinsun.com/prize/about
4 messages were moved from this topic to #general > The Justin Sun Prize by Rob Lewis.
"Recipients must claim their prize in cryptocurrency"
I'm afraid that it's a cryptocurrency scam

Note that the person behind the prize is notorious or to say the least highly controversial. He knows little about the math behind these problems. This is one of his attention seeking behaviors, and he gains from it.

Reputation loss (and zero to negative monetary gain) is to be expected if one participates. Low quality submissions (as the deleted analysis mentioned above had shown) are also expected.
